body: I HATE jerky but LOVE Beest. It's salty, savory and meets all my macros as someone with insulin resistance. Skip the jerky and go Beest!

I had high hopes for your product but I will be eating the purchase cost and moving on. It was not only the trail mix but all your products which did not meet expectations. It was my fault for not reading the descriptions as "crunchy" so I take responsibility for that. The taste and texture was off putting and unenjoyable. My wife described the jerky as a meat cracker with a weird after taste and a texture that might crack your teeth. I wish you the best and hope your endeavor is successful but I will not be one of your continuing customers.

Crunchy Jerky’s pork snack is fantastic! It has the same great crunch as the beef version but with a milder, less salty flavor that makes it perfect for different uses. It’s great on its own, or you can easily pair it with dips, salads, or keto meals. High in protein, light, and not greasy—an excellent choice for anyone looking for a flavorful, versatile snack.

Shopping with BEEST Snacks was smooth and easy. The website was clear, checkout was quick, and my order arrived on time and well-packaged. I appreciated the updates on shipping and how simple it was to find what I was looking for. Overall, a great experience—thank you for the excellent service!

Crunchy Jerky is an amazing beef snack! It has a great crisp texture that’s different from regular jerky—light, crunchy, and full of rich beef flavor. It’s high in protein, perfectly fits my keto lifestyle, and keeps me satisfied between meals. I also love that it’s not greasy or overly salty. Overall, it’s a tasty, guilt-free snack that delivers exactly what it promises.
